name: Seyla Benhabib
shortBio: Turkish-born American critical theorist and political philosopher who transformed Habermasian discourse ethics with the "concrete other" and synthesized Hannah Arendt's "right to have rights" into cosmopolitan democratic iterations.
centralQuestion: How can universal human rights and deliberative democracy be reconciled with cultural plurality and the ethical demands of embodied "concrete others"?

keyWorks.title: Situating the Self: Gender, Community and Postmodernism in Contemporary Ethics
keyWorks.description: Develops interactive universalism distinguishing the "generalized other" of formal justice from the "concrete other" of narrative care.

keyWorks.title: The Rights of Others: Aliens, Residents, and Citizens
keyWorks.description: Advances cosmopolitan federalism and democratic iterations grounded in Arendt's right to have rights.
